title: Wearable Evaluation of Ambulatory Readings for Blood Pressure
official: Wearable Evaluation of Ambulatory Readings for Blood Pressure
summary: The purpose of this project is to compare the performance and validity of novel wearable technologies that measure blood pressure (BP) and physical activity with a Spacelabs Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring (ABPM) device.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 to 100 years
* All neighborhoods in Boston area
* Be able to walk with two limbs and have two arms
* Willing and able to complete required measurement procedures
* Able to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Failure to receive informed consent
* Arm circumference of more than 50cm
